correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed 17 closed neighborhoods N[v]=v+({0}∪Q), Q={1,2,4,8,9,13,15,16}; exhaustive submasks yield 6851 nonempty faces and f-vector (17,136,680,1734,2074,1428,612,153,17). Independently replayed the exact vertex-toggle sequence and sorted mask pairing: 3399 pairs, one critical vertex and 52 critical 3-simplices. Built all 33847 reversed-matching Hasse incidences and performed Kahn topological sort visiting all 6851 faces, certifying global acyclicity. Forman discrete Morse CW then has a point and 52 3-cells with trivial S² attaching maps, proving the integral wedge, not merely mod-p ranks.
residual_risks: Exhaustive computation only establishes this finite graph, not larger Paley graphs; the directed graph acyclicity is the critical finite certificate.
